newsitem.title: CHINA: Southern China ethylene plant ramps up production.
newsitem.headline: Southern China ethylene plant ramps up production.

text.p: An ethylene plant at Maoming, in China's southern province of Guangdong had produced 54,000 tonnes of ethylene by the end of 1996, the China news service said on Monday.
The plant, which started trial production in August, was expected to produce 300,000 tonnes of ethylene a year, the report said.
Revenues reached 400 million yuan ($48 million) last year, it said but gave no further details.
The plant, with investment of more than 17 billion yuan, is 60 percent owned by China National Petrochemical Corp (SINOPEC) and 40 percent by the Guangdong provincial government.
